name: jev
description: Use hosted Jev Choice evaluation through a Go CLI with local configuration, focused output, and install/uninstall/doctor commands.

interface.shortDescription: Ask a question, choose an answer, control the output.
interface.longDescription: Provides a Go CLI and one usage skill for hosted Jev Choice evaluation, thresholds, JSON field selection, TOML configuration, installation, removal, and offline diagnosis. The binary and token are configured separately from plugin installation.
defaultPrompt: Use $jev:jev to evaluate my question against a supplied set of choices.
Use $jev:jev to configure Jev defaults or explain its CLI output and threshold behavior.
Use $jev:jev to install, uninstall, or diagnose the Jev CLI without changing shell settings.
